_source: Static draft-proposal form config (formerly the non-poll fields of the dropped fixture). field_limits + bodies derived from decentraland/governance src/entities/Proposal/types.ts newProposalDraftScheme; vpThreshold/vpUnit from governance page.submit.submission_vp_not_met (>=1000 VP). The final createProposal write is SIMULATED (Snapshot + Aragon run the DAO externally; no catalyrst write path).
